_doc: S6-B3092b lifecycle exemptions for the pre-leg bar audit (S6-B2947), keyed by tickers-file basename. DATA, not code (CSV-first): make_spec copies the matching block into every generated spec's preleg_exemptions, and preleg_bar_audit stamps exemptions_used per run. An exemption documents a LIFECYCLE absence (rename, delisting, exchange->OTC) - never interior corruption (L847). Added B3139q-r12b after the bl_step2_p4_250 chain HALTed: make_spec omitted the field config 1's spec carried, so the same two documented tickers refused the launch.
